name: Tripledot Games
location: London, UK / Barcelona, Spain / Warsaw, Poland
description: Tripledot Games is our flagship studio and the heart of the Tripledot group. We build casual puzzle games that have become some of the most-played mobile titles in the world ‚ Woodoku alone has been downloaded hundreds of millions of times. If you love obsessing over product quality and working with some of the sharpest minds in mobile gaming, this is your home.
culture: We move fast and care deeply about craft. Our culture is data-obsessed but genuinely collaborative‚ we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be surrounded by people who challenge you to do your best work every day.
unique: We sit at the intersection of world-class product thinking and deep data science. Every major decision is grounded in evidence, but there's real creative ambition behind the numbers. Ideas move fast here, and great ones get built.

name: Ludios
description: Ludios is our APAC casual puzzle games studio, based across Melbourne and Jakarta. Led by Tripledot co-founder Eyal Chameides, the studio combines deep game design expertise with a strong focus on craft and player experience, building casual puzzle games for a global audience.
culture: We're creative and craft-led, with a strong sense of ownership at every level. You'll have real autonomy over your work, a team that trusts you to deliver, and a founder who genuinely cares about building great games.
unique: We combine the creative sensibility of an indie studio with Tripledot's world-class data infrastructure. That means our games feel handcrafted, because they are, but they're also rigorously optimised for real players at scale.

name: PeopleFun
description: PeopleFun is our word games studio, based in Dallas, US. The studio is home to Wordscapes, one of the most successful and beloved word games, with hundreds of millions of downloads and a passionate global audience. The team focuses on building and evolving games that have meaningful, long-term relationships with their players.
culture: We're collaborative and remote-friendly, with a genuine love for word games and a strong sense of product ownership. We make decisions with data but we never forget that great games require creative instinct too.
unique: We've built and sustained one of the most beloved casual game franchises in mobile history. Wordscapes has a loyal player base that keeps coming back year after year, and we're still finding new ways to grow and innovate on top of that foundation.

name: Lion Studios
description: Lion Studios is our hyper-casual and hybrid-casual studio, operating across the US and Berlin. The team is behind Hexa Sort and the official mobile Wordle, combining elegant design with rapid, continuous testing. The studio specializes in moving quickly, learning through iteration, and turning simple concepts into global, chart-topping games.
culture: We have a strong bias to action ‚ ideas get prototyped fast, and data tells us what lives or dies. It's an energetic environment that rewards initiative and loves people who are hungry to see their work reach millions of players.
unique: We have a rare and proven ability to take a simple concept and scale it into a global hit. Our track record speaks for itself‚ and we're always looking for the next one.

name: Clipwire Games
description:
Clipwire is our a Toronto-based games studio behind MONOPOLY: Bingo!, The Price Is Right: Bingo!, and Bingo Story. For more than a decade, we’ve been creating social games that bring together iconic brands, creative ideas and a team that genuinely loves making games people come back to every day.

At Clipwire, talented people have a voice in what we build, the opportunity to do meaningful work, and the chance to work alongside people they genuinely enjoy. We’re passionate about creating great games - and an environment where great people can do their best work.
culture:
Work is a lot better when you actually like the people you work with - and luckily, we do. Whether we’re heading to our annual Blue Jays game, spending a summer day at our beach picnic, teaming up for a game jam, celebrating the holidays, or taking KitKat flavour rankings so seriously that they require an official spreadsheet, we find plenty of reasons to have fun together. It’s all part of a culture where people know each other, enjoy being around each other, and genuinely want to show up for the team.

There’s a real sense of community here. We celebrate wins, recognize the people behind them, and put time and effort into creating experiences for our team beyond the day-to-day work. At the same time, we trust people to be good at what they do. Experience is valued, ideas can come from anywhere, and people are given room to take ownership without a lot of unnecessary process getting in the way.
unique:
We’ve been around since 2012, and a lot of our people have been here for a big part of that journey. That history has created something pretty special: a team with deep experience, strong relationships, and a lot of trust in one another.

We’re big enough to work with some of the world’s most recognizable brands, but still small enough that your ideas can make a real impact. There aren’t endless layers between you and the work. People collaborate across disciplines, share ideas openly, and have the opportunity to shape the games and experiences we create. And while we care a lot about making great games, we care just as much about making Clipwire a great place to work.
games: Bingo Story; MONOPOLY: Bingo!; The Price Is Right: Bingo

name: Machine Zone
description: Machine Zone is our mid-core studio, based in the US. The studio is behind some of the most iconic strategy titles in mobile gaming, helping define the genre and build communities of millions of players. With over a decade of experience, Machine Zone specializes in operating games at massive scale.
culture: We're results-oriented and experienced. High standards, high output, and a deep respect for craft. This is a team that has seen a lot and knows how to operate at the highest level.
unique: We built some of the defining titles of the mid-core mobile era. That institutional knowledge, technical infrastructure and operational depth is genuinely hard to find anywhere else in the industry.

name: Athena Studio
description: Athena Studio is our casual puzzle games studio, based in Vietnam. The studio builds games for a global audience, combining strong technical capabilities with a fast-moving development approach. The team focuses on building and shipping at pace and is growing rapidly within the Tripledot group.
culture: We're energetic, collaborative, and serious about quality. The team is relatively young but punches well above its weight. It's a place where you can make a real impact quickly and shape the direction of the studio from the ground up.
unique: We're a studio on the rise, growing fast, building a strong track record, and doing it as part of one of the most successful mobile games companies in the world. If you want real ownership and the chance to grow with something exciting, this is the opportunity.

name: Zephyr Mobile
description: Zephyr Mobile is our casual puzzle studio within the Tripledot Games family. The studio focuses on reimagining classic puzzle formats for modern mobile players, with an emphasis on rapid testing, constant iteration, and building games that genuinely delight players.
culture: We operate with the agility of a startup and the resources of a scaled group. Small team, fast decisions, clear ownership ‚ and the backing of Tripledot's data and distribution infrastructure behind us.
unique: We have a rare combination: the speed and feel of a small studio with the tools, data, and reach of a much larger organisation. That's a genuinely powerful place to build from.
games: Get Color; Hey Color; Hey Wood; Matchstick and more!

name: Zenlife Games
description: ZenLife Game is our casual and word games studio, operating across China and Singapore. Formerly Zenjoy, the studio has deep expertise in creating games that resonate across both Eastern and Western markets - a cross-market capability that few studios have successfully developed.
culture: We're cross-cultural, ambitious, and genuinely curious about our players. Our team bridges different game development traditions and that diversity of perspective makes us better at what we do.
unique: We've solved something genuinely hard: building games that resonate deeply with very different audiences at the same time. That cross-cultural product expertise is rare and it's at the core of everything we build.

name: Zero Gravity
description: Zero Gravity is our social casino studio, based in China. We’ve built a strong portfolio of high-performing titles by combining deep genre expertise with sharp product instincts. The studio has a strong understanding of its players and genre, with a focus on building sustainable, long-term games and businesses.
culture: We're product-focused and commercially minded. We take our craft seriously and build with a clear sense of who we're building for. It's a focused, experienced team that values people who care as much about the details as we do.
unique: We've built a profitable, durable business in one of the most competitive genres in mobile gaming. Our understanding of social casino player behaviour and monetisation is a genuine competitive advantage, and it's taken years to develop.

name: Leyi
description: Leyi is our 4X strategy studio, based in China. We build large-scale strategy games with deep progression systems and long-term player communities. With over a decade of experience in the genre, the studio specializes in the patient, systems-driven design required to create strategy games that players stay with for years.
culture: We're ambitious, player-focused, and in it for the long game. Building strategy games that retain players for years requires a particular kind of care and rigour ‚ and that spirit runs through everything we do.
unique: 4X strategy is one of the most demanding genres in mobile. Deep systems, strong communities, long-term vision. We've built that capability over a decade and it's not something that can be shortcut.

name: Magic Tavern
description: Magic Tavern is our casual match-3 studio, based in China. We create visually rich games with strong narrative hooks and deep meta progression—games designed to keep players engaged over the long term. Project Makeover and Matchington Mansion have both built loyal, passionate player communities.
culture: We're creative and detail-oriented. Design and storytelling genuinely matter here‚ this is a studio where the quality of the work is a point of pride and people go the extra mile to get it right.
unique: We've built multiple successful franchises in the competitive match-3 space. Our ability to combine casual gameplay with genuine emotional resonance ‚ real characters, real stories, real stakes ‚ is what sets us apart.

name: Belka Games
description: Belka Games is Tripledot’s casual games studio, based in Cyprus, with a strong focus on long-running live games and player retention. Its flagship title, Clockmaker, has maintained players for over a decade, reflecting the studio’s emphasis on patient, thoughtful product development and long-term player engagement.
culture: We're trust-based and outcomes-focused. We've built a culture on strong communication, clear ownership, and results over process.
unique: Fifteen years of building and operating live games gives us exceptional depth in live ops, player retention, and long-term game management. That experience is rare and it's built into how we think about everything we make.

name: PuzzlePlay
description: PuzzlePlay is Tripledot’s player rewards platform, where players can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes while playing Tripledot’s casual, free-to-play mobile games. PuzzlePlay connects players with games built and operated by Tripledot’s family of studios, turning everyday gameplay into opportunities to earn rewards.
unique: Every game in the PuzzlePlay rewards network is built or operated by Tripledot, so the team can focus on quality gameplay and long-term rewards rather than short-term offers. It's a key part of Tripledot's growth strategy.

name: Supersonic
description: Our hybrid-casual publishing label, based in Tel Aviv. Supersonic partners with independent game studios around the world to help them launch and scale their games, and joined Tripledot in 2026. It continues to operate under its own brand and management team, alongside Lion Studios.
unique: Supersonic is Tripledot's first team in Israel, bringing product, engineering and R&D strength along with advanced SDKs and user-acquisition automation technology.
